critique.evidence: Positive measured evidence: zero confirmed automated violations, no document-width overflow at 1440/768/390 px, no touch-target violations, keyboard traversal reaches the metrics section within the horizontal navigation, the skip-link target measures 158×46 px, and reduced-motion testing shows no hero animation. However, WCAG proof is materially incomplete at every viewport: 484–553 nodes need contrast review, 6 nodes have potentially prohibited ARIA attributes, and 2 nodes have potentially duplicate ARIA/label IDs with critical impact. There is also no measured proof that chart content/tooltips and all metrics data are keyboard- and assistive-technology-accessible.
critique.fix: Resolve and rerun the incomplete audits: verify or correct contrast for every flagged node, remove prohibited ARIA attributes, and make all referenced IDs unique. Add explicit keyboard and accessibility-tree tests for charts, tooltips, tables, focus visibility/order, and text alternatives at desktop, tablet, and mobile; retain the demonstrated no-overflow, touch-target, skip-link, and reduced-motion behavior.
